system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. original_prompt: Create a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a GKE Standard cluster with one node pool for production workloads.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Create a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a GKE Standard cluster with one node pool for production workloads.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.

resources:
- name: prod-vpc
  type: compute.v1.network
  properties:
    autoCreateSubnetworks: false
    routingConfig:
      routingMode: REGIONAL

- name: prod-gke-subnet
  type: compute.v1.subnetwork
  properties:
    region: us-central1
    network: $(ref.prod-vpc.selfLink)
    ipCidrRange: 10.10.0.0/20
    privateIpGoogleAccess: true
    secondaryIpRanges:
    - rangeName: gke-pods
      ipCidrRange: 10.20.0.0/16
    - rangeName: gke-services
      ipCidrRange: 10.30.0.0/20

- name: prod-nat-router
  type: compute.v1.router
  properties:
    region: us-central1
    network: $(ref.prod-vpc.selfLink)
    nats:
    - name: prod-nat
      natIpAllocateOption: AUTO_ONLY
      sourceSubnetworkIpRangesToNat: LIST_OF_SUBNETWORKS
      subnetworks:
      - name: $(ref.prod-gke-subnet.selfLink)
        sourceIpRangesToNat:
        - ALL_IP_RANGES
      enableEndpointIndependentMapping: true
      minPortsPerVm: 2048
      tcpEstablishedIdleTimeoutSec: 1200
      logConfig:
        enable: true
        filter: ERRORS_ONLY

- name: prod-gke-node-sa
  type: iam.v1.serviceAccount
  properties:
    accountId: prod-gke-node
    displayName: GKE prod node service account

  type: gcp-types/cloudresourcemanager-v1:virtual.projects.iamMemberBinding
  properties:
    resource: $(project)
    role: roles/logging.logWriter
    member: serviceAccount:$(ref.prod-gke-node-sa.email)

- name: bind-node-sa-metric-writer
  type: gcp-types/cloudresourcemanager-v1:virtual.projects.iamMemberBinding
  properties:
    resource: $(project)
    role: roles/monitoring.metricWriter
    member: serviceAccount:$(ref.prod-gke-node-sa.email)

- name: bind-node-sa-metadata-writer
  type: gcp-types/cloudresourcemanager-v1:virtual.projects.iamMemberBinding
  properties:
    resource: $(project)
    role: roles/stackdriver.resourceMetadata.writer
    member: serviceAccount:$(ref.prod-gke-node-sa.email)

- name: bind-node-sa-artifact-registry-reader
  type: gcp-types/cloudresourcemanager-v1:virtual.projects.iamMemberBinding
  properties:
    resource: $(project)
    role: roles/artifactregistry.reader
    member: serviceAccount:$(ref.prod-gke-node-sa.email)

- name: prod-gke-cluster
  type: gcp-types/container-v1:projects.locations.clusters
  metadata:
    dependsOn:
    - prod-gke-subnet
    - prod-nat-router
    - prod-gke-node-sa
    - bind-node-sa-logging-writer
    - bind-node-sa-metric-writer
    - bind-node-sa-metadata-writer
    - bind-node-sa-artifact-registry-reader
  properties:
    parent: projects/$(project)/locations/us-central1
    cluster:
      name: prod-gke
      description: Production GKE Standard regional cluster
      network: $(ref.prod-vpc.selfLink)
      subnetwork: $(ref.prod-gke-subnet.selfLink)
      releaseChannel:
        channel: STABLE
      locations:
      - us-central1-a
      - us-central1-b
      - us-central1-f
      ipAllocationPolicy:
        useIpAliases: true
        clusterSecondaryRangeName: gke-pods
        servicesSecondaryRangeName: gke-services
      privateClusterConfig:
        enablePrivateNodes: true
        enablePrivateEndpoint: false
        masterIpv4CidrBlock: 172.16.0.0/28
      masterAuthorizedNetworksConfig:
        enabled: true
        cidrBlocks:
        - displayName: corp-office
          cidrBlock: 203.0.113.0/24
      shieldedNodes:
        enabled: true
      networkPolicy:
        enabled: true
        provider: CALICO
      addonsConfig:
        httpLoadBalancing:
          disabled: false
        networkPolicyConfig:
          disabled: false
        dnsCacheConfig:
          enabled: true
        kubernetesDashboard:
          disabled: true
      loggingConfig:
        componentConfig:
          enableComponents:
          - SYSTEM_COMPONENTS
          - WORKLOADS
          - APISERVER
          - SCHEDULER
          - CONTROLLER_MANAGER
      monitoringConfig:
        managedPrometheus:
          enabled: true
        componentConfig:
          enableComponents:
          - SYSTEM_COMPONENTS
          - APISERVER
          - SCHEDULER
          - CONTROLLER_MANAGER
      workloadIdentityConfig:
        workloadPool: $(project).svc.id.goog
      maintenancePolicy:
        window:
          dailyMaintenanceWindow:
            startTime: "03:00"
      defaultMaxPodsConstraint:
        maxPodsPerNode: 110
      networkConfig:
        datapathProvider: ADVANCED_DATAPATH
        enableIntraNodeVisibility: true
      enableKubernetesAlpha: false
      nodePools:
      - name: prod-pool
        initialNodeCount: 3
        locations:
        - us-central1-a
        - us-central1-b
        - us-central1-f
        config:
          machineType: e2-standard-4
          diskType: pd-balanced
          diskSizeGb: 100
          imageType: COS_CONTAINERD
          serviceAccount: $(ref.prod-gke-node-sa.email)
          oauthScopes:
          - https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform
          metadata:
            disable-legacy-endpoints: "true"
          labels:
            env: prod
            pool: prod
          tags:
          - gke-prod
          shieldedInstanceConfig:
            enableIntegrityMonitoring: true
            enableSecureBoot: true
          workloadMetadataConfig:
            mode: GKE_METADATA
        management:
          autoUpgrade: true
          autoRepair: true
        autoscaling:
          enabled: true
          minNodeCount: 3
          maxNodeCount: 10
        upgradeSettings:
          maxSurge: 1
          maxUnavailable: 0
